facts.label: Problema e motivo
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para contar o que aconteceu e because para dar o motivo: I forgot because I was in a hurry.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o problema, use o passado simples: My computer stopped. I opened a file. Para perguntas, use did + verbo base: Did you save the file? A resposta curta é No, I didn’t.

facts.label: Porque
facts.sub: Para dar o motivo, use because + frase completa: I forgot because I was in a hurry. Para perguntar o motivo, use Why? Why do you look worried?

compare.ask: I forgot because I was in a hurry.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “esqueci porque estava com pressa”.
compare.tip: Diga: “I forgot because I was in a hurry.”
compare.us: Em inglês: I forgot because I was in a hurry. No passado, use verbos como opened, called e irregulares como lost, forgot.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: I forgot because I was in a hurry.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

decode.why: The message says the file was not saved.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use because to give a reason.

items.why: We say Did you save it?

items.s: The past of forget is forgot.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use because to give a reason. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Did you saved it?”. → Falso (We say Did you save it?)
The past of forget is forgot. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A modern office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a modern office in Sydney. Sunlight shines on long white desks. Xavier sits at his desk with a coffee. His coworker Rui walks in slowly. His face looks tired and sad. Xavier asks what is wrong.
“Rui, why do you look worried?” says Xavier. “Because my computer stopped yesterday. I lost my work.” says Rui. “What happened?” says Xavier.
